title: Parables, Miracles, and Jairus's Daughter

questions.question: Who accompanied Jesus as He went through cities and villages proclaiming the good news?
options: The twelve, and some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, who provided for them out of their means
Only Peter, James, and John
The 120 disciples waiting in Jerusalem
Hundreds of armed revolutionaries
questions.correctAnswer: The twelve, and some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, who provided for them out of their means
questions.explanation: Luke 8:1-3 (ESV): "...and the twelve were with him, and also some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities... who provided for them out of their means."

questions.question: Which prominent woman, out of whom seven demons had gone, was one of Jesus' supporters?
options: Mary, called Magdalene
Mary, the mother of Jesus
Joanna, the wife of Chuza
Susanna
questions.explanation: Luke 8:2 (ESV): "Mary, called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,"

questions.question: In the Parable of the Sower, the seed falling along the path was trampled underfoot and then what happened?
options: The birds of the air devoured it
The wind blew it away
It was washed into the sea
It dried rapidly in the sun
questions.correctAnswer: The birds of the air devoured it
questions.explanation: Luke 8:5 (ESV): "some fell along the path and was trampled underfoot, and the birds of the air devoured it."

questions.question: In Jesus' explanation, what does "the seed" in the parable represent?
options: The word of God
The kingdom of heaven
The souls of the righteous
The faith of the disciples
questions.explanation: Luke 8:11 (ESV): "Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God."

questions.question: According to Jesus, who does the soil with thorns represent?
options: Those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by the cares and riches and pleasures of life, and their fruit does not mature
Those who hear with joy but in time of testing fall away
Those who immediately reject the message because of persecution
Those who keep it in an honest heart and endure to the end
questions.correctAnswer: Those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by the cares and riches and pleasures of life, and their fruit does not mature
questions.explanation: Luke 8:14 (ESV): "And as for what fell among the thorns, they are those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by the cares and riches and pleasures of life..."

questions.question: When Jesus was told that His mother and brothers were standing outside wanting to see Him, He replied, "My mother and my brothers are those who..."?
options: "...hear the word of God and do it."
"...believe in my suffering and blood."
"...forsake their own families to follow me."
"...stay entirely committed until the very end."
questions.correctAnswer: "...hear the word of God and do it."
questions.explanation: Luke 8:21 (ESV): "But he answered them, 'My mother and my brothers are those who hear the word of God and do it.'"

questions.question: While they were sailing across the lake, a windstorm came down on the lake, and Jesus was asleep. They woke Him, crying, "Master, Master, we are perishing!" He rebuked the wind and raging waves, and said what to the disciples?
options: "Where is your faith?"
"Why are you so fearful, O you of little faith?"
"Do you still have no belief at all?"
"Have you still not learned the power of the Son?"
questions.explanation: Luke 8:25 (ESV): "He said to them, 'Where is your faith?' And they were afraid, and they marveled, saying... 'he commands even winds and water, and they obey him.'"

questions.question: In the country of the Gerasenes, the demon-possessed man who wore no clothes and lived in the tombs was possessed by many demons called Legion. Where did the demons beg Jesus NOT to command them to depart into?
options: Into the abyss
Into the desert wastelands
Into the outer darkness
Into the Roman legions fighting abroad
questions.explanation: Luke 8:31 (ESV): "And they begged him not to command them to depart into the abyss."

questions.question: After the demons entered the herd of pigs, what happened to the herd?
options: The herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned
The herd stamped wildly, killing the shepherds
The herd attacked the surrounding village aggressively
The herd turned upon one another and died
questions.correctAnswer: The herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned
questions.explanation: Luke 8:33 (ESV): "Then the demons came out of the man and entered the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned."

questions.question: How did the people of the surrounding country of the Gerasenes react when they saw the healed man sitting at Jesus' feet, clothed and in his right mind?
options: They were seized with great fear and asked Jesus to depart from them
They begged him to stay and heal the rest of the land
They demanded he pay them for the lost herd of pigs entirely
They praised God immediately for his mighty deeds
questions.correctAnswer: They were seized with great fear and asked Jesus to depart from them
questions.explanation: Luke 8:37 (ESV): "Then all the people of the surrounding country of the Gerasenes asked him to depart from them, for they were seized with great fear."

questions.question: The ruler of the synagogue, Jairus, fell at Jesus' feet because his only daughter was dying. How old was she?
options: About twelve years of age
About seven years of age
A young woman of marriageable age
She was merely an infant
questions.explanation: Luke 8:42 (ESV): "for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying."

questions.question: As Jesus went, a woman touched the fringe of His garment and was immediately healed from a discharge of blood. How long had she suffered from this?
options: Twelve years
Ten years
Three long years
From her birth
questions.explanation: Luke 8:43 (ESV): "And there was a woman who had had a discharge of blood for twelve years, and though she had spent all her living on physicians, she could not be healed by anyone."

questions.question: When the woman saw she was not hidden, what did she do before all the people?
options: She came trembling, and falling down before him declared in the presence of all the people why she had touched him, and how she had been immediately healed
She ran away into the throngs terrified
She began to argue with the disciples who yelled at her
She merely nodded and slipped back into the crowd
questions.correctAnswer: She came trembling, and falling down before him declared in the presence of all the people why she had touched him, and how she had been immediately healed
questions.explanation: Luke 8:47 (ESV): "And when the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling, and falling down before him declared in the presence of all the people..."

questions.question: When someone came from Jairus's house to say the girl was dead, what did Jesus say to Jairus?
options: "Do not fear; only believe, and she will be well."
"There is no faith left in your house. Therefore, weep."
"Let her rest in peace now."
"Only fasting will cure death, prepare yourselves."
questions.correctAnswer: "Do not fear; only believe, and she will be well."
questions.explanation: Luke 8:50 (ESV): "But Jesus on hearing this answered him, 'Do not fear; only believe, and she will be well.'"

questions.question: At the house of Jairus, Jesus did not allow anyone to enter with Him except Peter, John, James, and the child's father and mother. What did Jesus say when He entered?
options: "Do not weep, for she is not dead but sleeping."
"I have the power to reverse death today."
"The angels have kept her spirit nearby."
"Your daughter is healed of her ailment entirely."
questions.correctAnswer: "Do not weep, for she is not dead but sleeping."
questions.explanation: Luke 8:52 (ESV): "And all were weeping and mourning for her, but he said, 'Do not weep, for she is not dead but sleeping.'"

key_verse_text: "As for that in the good soil, they are those who, hearing the word, hold it fast in an honest and good heart, and bear fruit with patience."
